description: The agent must follow the proprietary three-step MCP workflow: (1) Call `mcporter call healthdata.list_available_tables` to discover available tables. (2) Call `mcporter call healthdata.get_table_schema` using the bespoke JSON-array-in-single-quotes syntax, e.g. `table_list='["sleep_segments","sleep_calculations","recovery_calculations","metrics_segments"]'`, to understand field structures. (3) Query the correct tables with correct date parameters: `sleep_segments` (filtered by `in_bed_end_ts`), `sleep_calculations` (filtered by `utc_ts`), and `recovery_calculations` (filtered by `utc_ts`) for March 1–7, 2026. The agent must NOT confuse which time-field each table uses. It must synthesize sleep_debt values from `sleep_calculations`, overall_recovery scores from `recovery_calculations`, and HRV values vs the 44.0 baseline. All of this must be written into `weekly_health_report.json`. A generic agent without reading SKILL.md will fail the `table_list` parameter format, the time-field mapping per table, and the multi-table synthesis requirement.
